create_FromPreviousTimeStepCalculator: create a FromPreviousTimeStepCalculator instance that computes time steps based on the previous non-sawtooth dt
build_FromPreviousTimeStepCalculatorStat: build a FromPreviousTimeStepCalculatorState with a previous_non_sawtooth_dt JAX array
run_initial_state: run initial_state to return the initial time step calculator state from runtime params
run_get_updated_state: run get_updated_state to update the time step calculator state after a simulation step
run__next_dt: run _next_dt to calculate the next time step duration using the previous non-sawtooth dt and reduction factor
